nom: RODAN + FIELDS Redefine Daily Clay Face Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one whose skin turns red at the slightest irritant and one in her 60s with fair, freckled, sensitive skin, report the cleanser leaves their skin clean and smooth without redness or irritation, unlike other exfoliating products they have tried.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s describe this daily light exfoliation as making the biggest difference in their skin quality of anything they have tried, consistent with the Redefine line's positioning for aging skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser does not dry out their skin, with one long-time user saying her skin is now never dry; however, one reviewer reports her skin became very dry after starting this product and plans to switch back to a different cleanser in the line.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with easily reddened, sensitive skin specifically report no redness reaction from this cleanser, unlike other exfoliating products they have used.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers note the cleanser does not cause breakouts, with one saying she hardly breaks out since using it.

aspects.libelle: Doubles as a daily wash and weekly mask
Small amount needed, tube lasts a long time
Has not been reformulated, unlike some other R+F products
Wished by one reviewer to be creamier
Shipping or postage delays reported by one reviewer
